properties.name: Eloy – Picacho
properties.story: A long-known farm-pumping subsidence area. The sinking belt is real but modest in this record.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (60 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km of the core); no mines nearby.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: Willcox basin
properties.story: The largest sinking area we found, in a valley with heavy irrigation pumping and the Willcox Playa crane habitat.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (24 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km); no mines nearby.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: North of Willcox
properties.story: A fast-sinking patch north of the Willcox basin, seen by three different satellite tracks.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: South of Willcox (Elfrida / McNeal area?)
properties.story: A second sinking area in the same valley system, confirmed from two look directions.
properties.land_use_note: Farmland all around (19 OpenStreetMap polygons within 3 km); no mines nearby. The place name is a guess.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area

properties.name: East of Willcox
properties.story: Large sinking area seen from one look direction only, so it is shown as unconfirmed.
properties.land_use_note: Little farmland nearby (0 to 2 polygons); the cause is unclear.
properties.source_note: Sentinel-1 OPERA DISP-S1, 2016 to 2026; outline is the study box, not the sinking area
